reason: Textron overlaps only with Butler National's aerospace business: aircraft and defense work for business aviation, OEM and government customers. Butler's casino management business (Boot Hill Casino) has no counterpart at Textron. Butler is a diversified holding company, so a comp that matches only one material business gets at most 1. Textron is also a much larger OEM, while Butler mainly does FAA-approved modifications, avionics and electronics.
